title: How A Mantis Shrimp Punches So Hard

scenes.say: This tiny animal can break aquarium glass.
Meet the mantis shrimp. Fun fact: it's not even a real shrimp.
scenes.heading: MEET THE

scenes.say: Its club-like claw punches at about fifty miles per hour, in around three milliseconds.
scenes.label: in about 3 milliseconds

scenes.say: That's an acceleration of up to ten thousand times gravity. Like a bullet.
scenes.label: like a bullet

scenes.say: But the punch is so fast, the water can't get out of the way.
It forms a bubble that collapses with a shockwave. So the prey gets hit twice.
scenes.heading: THE TWIST

scenes.say: That's why aquarium keepers often use extra thick tanks.
Would you keep one as a pet?
